name: CLIP-NeRF
definition: A method that adds CLIP (a text-image pre-trained multimodal model) to provide greater freedom in shape operations and global deformation, using a disentangled conditional NeRF architecture.
summary: CLIP-NeRF is a neural radiance field method that enables fast text- or image-guided 3D scene editing by mapping semantic input directly to shape and appearance modifications via a disentangled conditional architecture.
